name: DielineKit Packaging Widgets
author: fahimshahriar0179

sections.description:
Give your visitors working packaging tools, right on your own pages:

  • Box dieline generator. Visitors pick a box style (tuck end cartons, mailer boxes, snap-lock bottoms, shipping boxes, sleeves), type a size and watch the exact dieline draw itself, with cut, fold and bleed lines and the flat sheet size.
  • Barcode and QR code generator. EAN-13, UPC-A, EAN-8 and UPC-E barcodes and QR codes at true print size, with check digits and scan checks, and free PNG downloads.
  • Sheet layout calculator. How many boxes fit on a press sheet, the waste, and the cost per box. A handy quoting aid for print shops.

Add a tool with the DielineKit widget block, or with a shortcode:

  • [dielinekit] – box dieline generator
  • [dielinekit widget="dieline" style="rett" unit="in"] – starting on a mailer box, in inches
  • [dielinekit widget="barcode" type="ean13"] – barcode generator, starting on EAN-13
  • [dielinekit widget="sheet-layout"] – sheet layout calculator
  • [dielinekit attribution="yes"] – adds an optional credit line under the widget

Shortcode options: widget (dieline, barcode, sheet-layout), style (rte, ste, rett, snaplock, rsc, sleeve), unit (mm, in), type (qr, ean13, upca, ean8, upce), height (starting height in pixels), attribution (yes or no; no by default).

The widgets are free to use on any site. Widgets resize themselves to fit their content. No account or API key is needed.

External services

This plugin shows tools hosted by DielineKit (https://dielinekit.com) inside an iframe. Nothing is sent until a page with a widget is viewed.

  • What is loaded and when: when a visitor views a page containing a DielineKit block or shortcode, their browser loads the widget from https://dielinekit.com/embed/. The block editor also loads a preview of the widget while you edit a page containing the block.
  • What is sent: the widget address, which includes your site’s domain name (so DielineKit can count which sites use its widgets) and the starting options you chose. As with any web page, the visitor’s browser also sends its IP address and user agent.
  • In the widget: the widget sets no cookies and stores nothing in the visitor’s browser. DielineKit records anonymous usage events (for example, that a widget was loaded or which box style was chosen) and error reports, together with your site’s domain. Barcode numbers, links and other text typed into a widget stay in the visitor’s browser and are not sent to DielineKit unless the visitor chooses to open the full tool on dielinekit.com.

DielineKit terms of service: https://dielinekit.com/terms
DielineKit privacy policy: https://dielinekit.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the zip file, or search for “DielineKit Packaging Widgets”.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Edit a page, add the DielineKit widget block (or a [dielinekit] shortcode) and choose a tool in the block settings.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes. The plugin and the widgets are free, for personal and commercial sites.

Does the plugin add a link to my site?

Not unless you ask it to. The optional credit line under a widget is off by default; turn it on in the block settings or with attribution="yes". The widget itself shows a small “Powered by DielineKit” note in its own footer.

Will it slow my site down?

The widget runs in its own frame and loads lazily, when a visitor scrolls near it. The plugin adds one small script (about 1 KB) to pages that contain a widget, and nothing to other pages.

What happens when a visitor wants more than the widget offers?

Buttons such as “Open My Dieline” and “SVG” open dielinekit.com in a new tab with the visitor’s box or code filled in, so your page stays open.
